retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for high-contrast monochrome photography featuring a central large figure and smaller background figures on a curved horizon with vibrant, layered diagonal text.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white photograph of a central figure in a long dark dress, set within a curved, white circular room. Smaller figures stand on the horizon line. The top left features a large, vibrant script logo tilted diagonally, partially obscured by a yellow banner.
coreVisualRelationships: Central large figure vs. small peripheral figures
Curved floor line vs. rectangular frame
Monochrome image vs. saturated neon typography
Diagonal text orientation vs. vertical subject
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white photography for the subjects
Curved horizon line suggesting a circular or fisheye space
Diagonal text placement in the upper left quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central figure dominates the left-center; four smaller figures distributed along a curved horizon line in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the vibrant purple script logo in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left logo, follows the diagonal banner down to the central figure, then sweeps across the curved horizon to the background figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive white/grey curved wall provides significant breathing room around the subjects.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant purple and neon green for the script logo
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for the horizontal banner
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme contrast between the dark silhouettes and the bright white background; high saturation in the graphic elements only.

letterConstructionRules: Script: Thick, brush-like strokes with a neon green outline
Sans-serif: Wide, geometric, all-caps with high tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'R' has an elongated tail
The banner text is compressed and slanted to match the diagonal tilt
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, heavy script paired with a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for balance.

avoid: Vertical alignment for the main logo

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, hand-drawn energy of the main logo
Matches the geometric, wide-tracked 70s sans-serif aesthetic

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of a woman in a long black dress in a white circular room with a curved floor line. Place four small men in 70s attire along the curved horizon in the background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large purple script logo with a neon green outline at a 30-degree diagonal in the top left. Place a yellow banner across it with black sans-serif text. Add wide-tracked white sans-serif text in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the main logo tilted diagonally?
Is the tracking on the top-right text sufficiently wide?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or band logos
Ensure the background figures are generic 70s-style silhouettes

avoid: Muted or pastel colors in the graphics

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast black and white balance
Verify the diagonal banner is present
Ensure the background figures are small relative to the foreground
Confirm the script logo has a neon outline
Check that the top-right text is all-caps and wide-tracked
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome fisheye photography + diagonal neon script + wide-tracked geometric sans-serif.
